PcosSkinHair.6: PCOS ishobora gutera impinduka zigaragara ku ruhu, ku misatsi yo ku mubiri cyangwa ku musatsi wo ku mutwe. Kumenya aho bituruka bituma woroherwa no kubimenya no kumenya ibisubizo bishobora gutekerezwaho.
PcosSkinHair.7: Ibi bimenyetso birasanzwe, ariko ubwabyo ntibitegeka kandi ntibihagije ngo hemezwe PCOS.
PcosSkinHair.19: PCOS ishobora kujyana n’ubwiyongere bw’androgènes cyangwa ibikorwa byazo, ni imisemburo iba no mu bagore bisanzwe. Iyo ingaruka zayo ziyongereye, ishobora kugira ingaruka ku mpyiko z’amavuta y’uruhu, ku mizi y’imisatsi no ku buryo imisatsi ikura.
PcosSkinHair.20: Izi ngaruka z’imisemburo ni zo akenshi zisobanura acne ihoraho, imisatsi ikura cyane, cyangwa, ku bagore bamwe, umusatsi ugabanuka.
PcosSkinHair.22: Ibimenyetso bigaragara ntibigaragaza buri gihe uburemere bwa PCOS. Umugore umwe ashobora kugira ibimenyetso byinshi bigaragara, undi akagira bike cyangwa ntabigire na gato.
PcosSkinHair.23: Acne ifitanye isano n’impinduka z’imisemburo ishobora kugaragara cyangwa gukomeza no hanze y’ubwangavu. Akenshi iboneka ku gahanga k’akaboko k’urwasaya, ku rwasaya, ku matama yo hasi, cyangwa rimwe na rimwe ku ijosi.
PcosSkinHair.24: Ku bantu bamwe, ibishishi biba byimbitse, bibabaza kandi bikagaruka. Bishobora no gusiga ibimenyetso by’amabara cyangwa inkovu iyo bikanduwe cyangwa iyo biri mu mubyimba ukabije.
PcosSkinHair.26: Acne ihoraho, cyane cyane ku mugongo wo hasi w’mu maso
PcosSkinHair.28: Acne yiyongera rimwe na rimwe nyuma y’impinduka z’imisemburo
PcosSkinHair.29: Ibimenyetso cyangwa inkovu zisigaye nyuma ya acne
PcosSkinHair.30: Hirsutism ni ukwiyongera kw’imisatsi ikomeye ikura ahantu bidakunze kugaragara ku bagore. Ku bijyanye na PCOS, ishobora guhuzwa n’ingaruka za androgènes ku mizi y’imisatsi.
PcosSkinHair.31: Ahantu hakunze kugerwaho cyane ni ku gahanga k’akaboko k’urwasaya, hejuru y’iminwa, mu gituza, mu nda cyangwa mu mugongo. Ingano y’imisatsi ikura iratandukanye cyane ku muntu ku wundi.
PcosSkinHair.34: Imisatsi ikomeye ku rwasaya cyangwa hejuru y’iminwa
PcosSkinHair.35: Imisatsi ishobora gukura mu gituza, mu nda cyangwa mu mugongo
PcosSkinHair.36: Umusatsi ugenda ugabanuka buhoro buhoro hejuru y’umutwe
PcosSkinHair.38: Imikurire y’imisatsi iterwa kandi n’imiterere y’umuntu n’iy’umuryango. Kugira imisatsi igaragara ntibivuze ako kanya ko ufite PCOS.
PcosSkinHair.39: Abagore bamwe bafite PCOS babona kandi ko umusatsi wabo ugabanutse. Kugabanuka gushobora kugaragara cyane hejuru y’umutwe cyangwa ku nzira yo hagati y’umusatsi.
PcosSkinHair.40: Ibi bishobora kuza buhoro buhoro. Ni ngombwa gutandukanya ugwa k’umusatsi guterwa n’imisemburo n’izindi mpamvu zishoboka, nko kubura intungamubiri, ikibazo cya thyroïde, imiti imwe n’imwe, cyangwa igihe cy’umutima uhangayitse cyane.
PcosSkinHair.42: Umusatsi ugwa cyane, vuba cyangwa mu buryo budasanzwe ukwiye gusuzumwa na muganga kugira ngo hamenyekane impamvu.
PcosSkinHair.43: Uburyo bworoshye kandi buhoraho busanzwe bumeze neza kurusha gukoresha ibicuruzwa byinshi. Intego ni ugusukura, gutosa no kurinda uruhu mu gihe ugabanya ikintu cyose gishobora gukomeza kurubabaza.
PcosSkinHair.44: Uburyo bwiza kandi buhoraho bwo kwita ku ruhu
PcosSkinHair.48: Iyo umusatsi uba woroshye, bishobora gufasha kugabanya ibiwubabaza kenshi: ubushyuhe bukabije, uburyo bwo kuwuboha bukomeye cyane, cyangwa imiti y’ibinyabutabire ikoreshwa kenshi.
PcosSkinHair.49: Kujya kureba muganga w’uruhu bishobora kugirira akamaro iyo umusatsi ukomeje kugabanuka, kugira ngo hamenyekane impamvu kandi hasuzumwe uburyo bwo kuvura buhari.
PcosSkinHair.51: Hitamo ibicuruzwa byoroheje kandi wirinde gukoresha imiti myinshi ibabaza uruhu icyarimwe
PcosSkinHair.52: Sukura uruhu utarwangije, mu gitondo no ku mugoroba iyo bibaye ngombwa
PcosSkinHair.53: Rinda uruhu izuba iyo ruri hanze
PcosSkinHair.54: Irinde gukanda ibishishi kugira ngo ugabanye ibimenyetso n’inkovu
PcosSkinHair.55: Saba inama umuhanga iyo ibimenyetso bikomeje cyangwa byiyongera
PcosSkinHair.56: Uburyo bwo kwivuza buterwa n’ibimenyetso, uko bikomeye, ingaruka byagize ku buzima bwa buri munsi, n’intego za buri mugore. Birashobora gufasha gukorera ku buryo bwinshi aho gushaka igisubizo kimwe gusa.
PcosSkinHair.58: Uburyo bukwiye bwo kwita ku ruhu n’inama za muganga w’uruhu iyo bibaye ngombwa.
PcosSkinHair.60: Ibisubizo by’ubwiza cyangwa by’ubuvuzi bitewe n’uko bimeze.
PcosSkinHair.62: Menya impamvu mbere yo guhitamo uburyo bwo kuvura.
PcosSkinHair.64: Ita ku ngaruka z’ibimenyetso ku mutima.
PcosSkinHair.65: Ni byiza kuvugana n’umuganga iyo acne ikomeje cyangwa ikubabaza, iyo imisatsi yiyongera vuba, iyo umusatsi ugabanutse cyane, cyangwa iyo ibi bijyanye n’imihango idahoraho cyane.
PcosSkinHair.66: Muganga w’uruhu ashobora kwita ku bimenyetso by’uruhu n’imisatsi. Muganga w’abagore cyangwa undi muhanga ubifitiye ubushobozi na we ashobora gusuzuma imisemburo n’ibindi bimenyetso bishoboka bya PCOS.
PcosSkinHair.67: Jya kwa muganga iyo bibaye ngombwa
PcosSkinHair.68: Imisatsi ikura vuba kandi cyane, umusatsi ugwa tubonye, cyangwa impinduka z’imisemburo zidasanzwe bisaba inama za muganga.
PcosSkinHair.69: Kugira acne ntibivuze ako kanya ko ufite PCOS
PcosSkinHair.70: Imisatsi igaragara ntijyana buri gihe n’imisemburo gusa
PcosSkinHair.71: PCOS ishobora kugera ku bagore b’imiterere yose y’umubiri
PcosSkinHair.72: Ibimenyetso bishobora guhinduka uko igihe gihita kandi ntibingana ku bagore bose
PcosSkinHair.73: Ibimenyetso bigaragara bya PCOS bishobora kurakaza, ariko ntibigena ubugore bwawe, agaciro kawe cyangwa isuku yawe.
PcosSkinHair.75: PCOS ishobora kugira ingaruka ku ruhu, ku misatsi yo ku mubiri no ku musatsi wo ku mutwe.
PcosSkinHair.76: Ibimenyetso biratandukanye cyane ku mugore ku wundi.
PcosSkinHair.77: Ikimenyetso kimwe ntigihagije ngo hemezwe PCOS.
PcosSkinHair.79: Ubufasha bwa muganga bushobora kugufasha guhitamo uburyo bukubereye.
PcosSkinHair.81: Acne, imisatsi myinshi ikura cyangwa umusatsi ugwa bishobora kuba ibimenyetso bya PCOS, ariko si ko bigomba kuba. Uburyo bukwiranye nawe bushobora kugufasha kwita ku bimenyetso neza no kumva umerewe neza buri munsi.
PcosSkinHair.82: Iyi nkuru ni iy’amakuru gusa kandi ntisimbura kujya kwa muganga, isuzuma cyangwa ubuvuzi bwihariye.
PcosSkinHair.83: Uruhu, umusatsi n’ibimenyetso bigaragara bya PCOS — AWA

PerineumStrengthening.1:
Gukomeza imikaya yo mu nda yo hasi
nyuma yo kubyara
PerineumStrengthening.6: Nyuma yo gutwita no kubyara, imikaya yo mu nda yo hasi (pelvic floor) ikenera igihe cyo gukira. Imyitozo yoroheje, ikorwa buri gihe kandi buhoro buhoro, ishobora kugufasha kongera imbaraga, kugenzura no kwigirira icyizere, utarimo kwihutisha ibintu.
PerineumStrengthening.10: Igihe cyo gutangira imyitozo yo gukomeza imikaya yo mu nda yo hasi
PerineumStrengthening.18: Gukomeza imikaya yo mu nda yo hasi nyuma yo kubyara — AWA
PerineumStrengthening.20: Perineum, yitwa kandi pelvic floor, ni itsinda ry’imikaya iri hasi y’igitsina cy’imbere. Ifasha kugenzura uruhago n’amara kandi ifasha gushyigikira ibice by’imbere byo mu nda yo hasi.
PerineumStrengthening.21: Mu gihe cyo gutwita, iyi mikaya ikorera uburemere bwiyongereye mu mezi menshi. Iyo kubyara na ho irahangayika cyane.
PerineumStrengthening.23: Pelvic floor igira uruhare mu mirimo myinshi ya buri munsi: gufunga inkari n’umwanda, kugenzura imyuka, gushyigikira ibice byo mu nda yo hasi, no kugira uruhare mu mirimo imwe y’imibonano mpuzabitsina.
PerineumStrengthening.25: Gukomeza buhoro buhoro kandi mu buryo bukwiye bishobora gufasha kunoza kugenzura no gushyigikira kwa pelvic floor.
PerineumStrengthening.28: Pelvic floor igira uruhare mu kugenzura uruhago. Kuyikomeza buhoro buhoro bishobora gufasha kugabanya inkari zimwe zisohoka ku buryo butateguwe.
PerineumStrengthening.31: Iyi mikaya kandi ifasha kugenzura imyuka n’umwanda kandi igira uruhare mu gushyigikira ibice byo mu nda yo hasi.
PerineumStrengthening.33: Gushyigikira ibice byo mu nda yo hasi
PerineumStrengthening.34: Pelvic floor ni nk’urufatiro rw’imikaya rufasha gushyigikira uruhago, nyababyeyi n’amara.
PerineumStrengthening.37: Imyitozo ikwiye ishobora kandi kugufasha kongera kumenya no kugenzura neza aka gace.
PerineumStrengthening.38: Impamvu gutwita no kubyara bihangayikisha pelvic floor
PerineumStrengthening.39: Gutwita bishyira buhoro buhoro igitutu kinini kuri pelvic floor. Kubyara mu buryo busanzwe bishobora noneho kurambura cyane imikaya n’ibice by’umubiri biri aha hantu.
PerineumStrengthening.40: Kubyara hakoreshejwe kubagwa na byo ntibirinda pelvic floor burundu: gutwita ubwabyo ni igihe gikomeye kuri iyi mikaya.
PerineumStrengthening.41: Nyuma yo kubyara rero, ni ibisanzwe ko gukira bifata igihe. Abagore bamwe nta bimenyetso bumva, abandi bashobora kubona inkari zisohoka, kumva uburemere, cyangwa kugabanuka kw’ubushobozi bwo kugenzura imikaya.
PerineumStrengthening.43: Uburyo wabyayemo, gucika cyangwa gukata (episiotomy), kuba hari ububabare, n’uko umeze muri rusange nyuma yo kubyara, byose bishobora kugira ingaruka ku gukira.
PerineumStrengthening.44: Ni ryari watangira imyitozo yo gukomeza pelvic floor?
PerineumStrengthening.45: Nyuma yo kubyara nta kibazo, gukanda gake imikaya ya pelvic floor bishobora gusubukurwa buhoro buhoro. Biracyari ngombwa guhuza imyitozo n’uko umeze no gusaba inama niba wagize ikibazo, ububabare bukomeye, cyangwa uburyo bwihariye bwakorewe.
PerineumStrengthening.46: Niba ufite umuyoboro w’inkari (catheter), inama zimwe zivuga ko ukwiye gutegereza ko ukurwaho kandi ko kunyara bisanzwe kongera gukora mbere yo gutangira imyitozo ya perineum.
PerineumStrengthening.48: Ububabare bukomeye, ibimenyetso byiyongera, igisebe gikira nabi, cyangwa ikindi kibazo cyose bisaba inama z’umubyaza, muganga cyangwa umuhanga mu gufasha gukira.
PerineumStrengthening.50: Kugira ngo umenye ibyo ugomba gukora, tekereza ugerageza gufunga umwuka n’icyifuzo cyo kunyara icyarimwe. Icyo ushaka ni ukumva imikaya ikanda kandi izamuka imbere.
PerineumStrengthening.51: Intego si ugukanda umubiri wose cyane. Ikibuno, ibibero n’inda bigomba kuguma byoroshye uko bishoboka, mu gihe guhumeka bikomeza uko bisanzwe.
PerineumStrengthening.60: Kworoshya na ko ni ngombwa nk’uko
PerineumStrengthening.61: Nyuma yo gukanda buri gihe, reka imikaya yoroshye burundu. Gukira neza ntibivuze kugumisha perineum ikanze umunsi wose.
PerineumStrengthening.63: Mu ntangiriro, icy’ingenzi ni ukwiga kumenya imikaya no gukora igikorwa neza. Gukora buri gihe bifite akamaro kurusha gukora cyane.
PerineumStrengthening.65: Kanda pelvic floor byoroheje, hanyuma ugumane igikorwa amasegonda make utafunze umwuka. Hanyuma wirekure burundu mbere yo gutangira ukundi.
PerineumStrengthening.67: Iyo igikorwa kimaze kumenyerwa, hashobora kongerwamo gukanda vuba kandi guto. Bifasha kwitoza gukanda imikaya vuba iyo igitutu cyo mu nda cyiyongereye, urugero mbere gato yo gukorora cyangwa kwitsamura.
PerineumStrengthening.69: Huza imyitozo n’ikintu ukora buri munsi
PerineumStrengthening.73: Humeka uko bisanzwe mu gihe ukanda
PerineumStrengthening.80: Gukora buri gihe mbere ya byose
PerineumStrengthening.81: Guhuza imyitozo n’umuco usanzwe mu munsi wawe bishobora koroshya gukomeza: nyuma yo konsa, nyuma yo koza amenyo, cyangwa ikindi gihe kikubereye.
PerineumStrengthening.83: Imyitozo ya perineum ishobora kugaragara nk’iyoroshye, ariko biroroshye gukoresha indi mikaya cyangwa gukanda cyane.
PerineumStrengthening.84: Gukanda ikibuno cyangwa ibibero aho gukanda pelvic floor
PerineumStrengthening.86: Kugumisha imikaya ikanze buri gihe utayireka ngo yoroshye
PerineumStrengthening.87: Gukora imyitozo iminsi mike hanyuma ugahagarika
PerineumStrengthening.88: Guhagarika inkari ku bushake kugira ngo ugerageze gukanda
PerineumStrengthening.90: Ntibyemewe gukora imyitozo uhagarika inkari ku bushake. Ubu buryo ntibutoza perineum neza kandi bushobora guhungabanya imikorere isanzwe y’uruhago.
PerineumStrengthening.91: Ni ibihe bimenyetso bikwiye gutuma ujya kwa muganga?
PerineumStrengthening.92: Inkari nke zisohoka cyangwa ikintu kidasanzwe wumva rimwe na rimwe bishobora kuza nyuma yo kubyara. Icyakora ntibikwiye kwirengagizwa iyo bikomeje, byiyongera, cyangwa bibangamira ubuzima bwawe bwa buri munsi.
PerineumStrengthening.93: Inkari zisohoka iyo ukorora, witsamura, useka cyangwa wikoze imbaraga
PerineumStrengthening.94: Kumva uburemere cyangwa igitutu mu nda yo hasi
PerineumStrengthening.95: Kumva ko hari ikintu cyangwa ikibyimba kimanuka mu gitsina
PerineumStrengthening.96: Ingorane zo gufunga imyuka cyangwa umwanda
PerineumStrengthening.98: Ububabare mu gihe cyangwa nyuma yo gukora imibonano mpuzabitsina
PerineumStrengthening.99: Ingorane zo kumenya cyangwa gukanda neza imikaya ya perineum
PerineumStrengthening.101: Umubyaza, muganga cyangwa umuganga w’imyitozo ngororamubiri (physiotherapist) uzobereye mu gufasha gukira kwa pelvic floor ashobora gusuzuma imikorere y’imikaya akagusaba gahunda ikwiye.
PerineumStrengthening.102: Byagenda bite nyuma yo gucika, gukata (episiotomy) cyangwa kubagwa?
PerineumStrengthening.103: Gucika cyangwa gukata (episiotomy) bisaba kwitabwaho by’umwihariko mu gihe cyo gukira. Gusubukura ibikorwa bigomba kwita ku bubabare, uko inkovu imeze n’inama wahawe nyuma yo kubyara.
PerineumStrengthening.104: Nyuma yo kubagwa, gukira kandi bifitanye isano n’urukuta rw’inda n’inkovu. Nubwo kubyara bitabaye mu buryo busanzwe, gutwita ubwabyo byahangayikishije pelvic floor.
PerineumStrengthening.106: Iyo hari gucika gukomeye, ububabare, ibimenyetso by’inkari cyangwa by’amara, cyangwa ingorane zikomeje, isuzuma ku muganga ushinzwe ubuzima rishobora kugira akamaro cyane.
PerineumStrengthening.108: Gusubukura kugenda nyuma yo kubyara bigomba kuba buhoro buhoro. Kugenda n’ingendo zoroheje bishobora gusubukurwa bitewe n’uko wiyumva, mu gihe ibikorwa bikaze bisaba kwitonda cyane.
PerineumStrengthening.109: Mbere yo gusubukura kwiruka, gusimbuka cyangwa imyitozo ikaze cyane, ni byiza gusuzuma uko pelvic floor yakize no kwita ku bimenyetso byose.
PerineumStrengthening.111: Inkari zisohoka, kumva uburemere, cyangwa ububabare mu gihe cyangwa nyuma y’imyitozo ni ibimenyetso ko ugomba kugabanya umuvuduko ugasaba inama mbere yo kongera ubukana.
PerineumStrengthening.113: Imyitozo yo gukira kwa pelvic floor hamwe n’umubyaza cyangwa physiotherapist ishobora kugira akamaro niba utizeye ko ukanda neza, niba ibimenyetso bikomeje, cyangwa niba ushaka gusubukura ibikorwa bimwe by’umubiri wizeye.
PerineumStrengthening.115: Ese ibimenyetso byanjye bihuye no koroha kwa pelvic floor?
PerineumStrengthening.117: Ni inshuro zingahe nkwiye gukora buri munsi?
PerineumStrengthening.118: Ese nshobora gusubira kwiruka, muri siporo, cyangwa mu myitozo ikaze?
PerineumStrengthening.119: Ese nkeneye imyitozo yo gukira hamwe n’umubyaza cyangwa physiotherapist?
PerineumStrengthening.120: Ese inkovu yanjye, gucika cyangwa kubagwa bisaba kwitonda mu buryo bwihariye?
PerineumStrengthening.122: Kubona umuhanga ntibivuze ako kanya ko hari ikibazo. Isomo rishobora gufasha kugenzura uburyo ukora, gusuzuma uko ukira, no kwiga gutera imbere neza.
PerineumStrengthening.124: Nyuma yo kubyara, ni ibisanzwe kudasubirana ako kanya ibyiyumviro cyangwa imbaraga z’imikaya wari ufite mbere yo gutwita.
PerineumStrengthening.125: Intego si ugukanda inshuro nyinshi uko bishoboka. Ahubwo ni ukongera gusubirana buhoro buhoro guhuza neza gukanda no kworoha, hanyuma ukabasha gukoresha iyi mikaya mu buryo busanzwe mu bikorwa bya buri munsi.
PerineumStrengthening.127: Kumenya neza igikorwa, amasegonda make y’inyongera yo gukanda, cyangwa kugabanuka kw’inkari zisohoka ni ibimenyetso bitanga icyizere.
PerineumStrengthening.130: Gutwita no kubyara bihangayikisha cyane pelvic floor.
PerineumStrengthening.131: Gukira buhoro buhoro ni ibisanzwe nyuma yo kubyara.
PerineumStrengthening.132: Imyitozo igomba gushyira imbere uburyo igikorwa gikorwa kuruta imbaraga.
PerineumStrengthening.133: Guhumeka no kworoha ni ngombwa nk’uko gukanda.
PerineumStrengthening.134: Inkari zisohoka, kumva uburemere, cyangwa ububabare buhoraho bikwiye inama z’umuhanga.
PerineumStrengthening.135: Imyitozo yo gukira hamwe n’umubyaza cyangwa physiotherapist ishobora kugufasha kongera kugenzura neza.
PerineumStrengthening.136: Gusubira muri siporo bigomba kuba buhoro buhoro, cyane cyane ku bikorwa bikaze.
PerineumStrengthening.138: Nyuma yo kubyara, umubiri wawe wanyuze mu mpinduka nyinshi. Perineum ikwiye kwitabwaho nk’ibindi bice by’umubiri wawe: buhoro buhoro, buri gihe kandi nta gihato.
PerineumStrengthening.139: Iyi nkuru ni iy’amakuru gusa kandi ntisimbura inama za muganga zihariye. Niba ufite ububabare, ibimenyetso bikomeje, cyangwa impungenge zose ku gukira kwawe, saba inama umuganga ushinzwe ubuzima.

PeriodPain.14: Ububabare bushobora gutandukana hagati y’ukwezi n’ukundi kandi ntibuhora ari bumwe.
PeriodPain.16: Icupa ry’amazi ashyushye ku nda yo hasi rishobora koroshya imikaya.

PeriodPain.25: Niba ububabare bugutesha kubaho mu buryo busanzwe buri kwezi nubwo ukoresha ibi bisubizo, ni ngombwa kuvugana n’umuganga ushinzwe ubuzima.
PeriodPain.27: Ububabare bukabije cyane, kuva amaraso menshi, kunanirwa gukabije, cyangwa ibimenyetso bidasanzwe.

PeriodPain.31: Kurikirana ukwezi kwawe kugira ngo usobanukirwe neza ububabare bwawe

Pms.4: PMS igera kuri 8 mu bagore 10. Kunanirwa, kurakara, inda yaguye… Gusobanukirwa impamvu zayo no gukurikiza imigenzo myiza bishobora kunoza cyane iki gihe cy’ukwezi.
Pms.11: Syndrome ibanziriza imihango ihuza ibimenyetso by’umubiri n’iby’umutima bigaragara akenshi iminsi 5 kugeza kuri 10 mbere y’imihango yawe kandi bikagenda mu ntangiriro y’ukwezi kw’imihango.
Pms.13: Ibimenyetso bigaragara mbere y’imihango yawe kandi akenshi bigabanuka iyo itangiye.
Pms.15: Ubukana n’ubwoko bw’ibimenyetso bishobora gutandukana cyane ku mugore ku wundi, no hagati y’ukwezi n’ukundi.
Pms.19: Inda yaguye, ububabare, kunanirwa, kuribwa umutwe
Pms.21: Kwifuza isukari, guhinduka kw’ubushake bwo kurya, kunanirwa
Pms.23: Ingorane zo gusinzira cyangwa gusinzira nabi
Pms.24: Guhindagurika kw’imisemburo, cyane cyane progestérone na œstrogène, bigira ingaruka ku bimenyetso bitwara ubutumwa mu bwonko (sérotonine, dopamine), bishobora gusobanura ibimenyetso by’umutima n’iby’umubiri bya PMS.
Pms.26: Guhindagurika kw’imisemburo bishobora kugira ingaruka ku mitekerereze, imbaraga, gusinzira n’ibyiyumviro bimwe by’umubiri.
Pms.28: Kunywa amazi ahagije bifasha kugabanya inda yaguye.
Pms.30: Hitamo ibiribwa bikungahaye kuri magnésium, omega-3 na vitamine B.
Pms.32: Imyitozo ngororamubiri isohora endorphines kandi igabanya umunaniro w’umutima.
Pms.34: Imyitozo yo guhumeka, kuzirikana, kwandika ibyo wiyumva… Shaka icyagukorera.
Pms.37: Ni ryari ukwiye gusaba inama za muganga?
Pms.38: Niba ibimenyetso bikomeye cyane kandi bigira ingaruka ku buzima bwawe bwa buri munsi, bishobora kuba ari premenstrual dysphoric disorder (PMDD). Ntutinye kujya kureba umuganga ushinzwe ubuzima.
Pms.39: Syndrome ibanziriza imihango (PMS): muyisobanukirwe neza — AWA

PostpartumPeriodReturn.1:
Kugaruka kw’imihango nyuma yo kubyara,
ibyo witeze
PostpartumPeriodReturn.4: Nyuma yo kubyara, imihango yawe ishobora gufata igihe kugira ngo igaruke. Igihe cyayo gitandukana bitewe n’konsa, mu bindi, kandi buri muntu ashobora kubona iki gihe mu buryo butandukanye.
PostpartumPeriodReturn.5: Kugaruka kw’imihango nyuma yo kubyara, ibyo witeze — AWA
PostpartumPeriodReturn.6: 1. Kugaruka kw’imihango nyuma yo kubyara ni iki?
PostpartumPeriodReturn.7: “Kugaruka kw’imihango” bivuga imihango yawe igarutse nyuma yo kubyara. Ukwezi kw’imihango ntigusubira ako kanya mu buryo busanzwe.
PostpartumPeriodReturn.9: Nta gihe kimwe gikurikizwa na bose.
PostpartumPeriodReturn.11: Igihe giterwa cyane n’konsa. Utonsa, imihango yawe ishobora kugaruka akenshi nyuma y’ibyumweru 6 kugeza kuri 8. Wonsa gusa, ishobora gutinda amezi menshi.
PostpartumPeriodReturn.17: Ukwezi kugaruka buhoro buhoro nyuma yo kubyara. Konsa bishobora kugira ingaruka ku gihe imihango yawe igarukira.
PostpartumPeriodReturn.21: Ukwezi kw’imihango guhagarara by’agateganyo nyuma yo kubyara.
PostpartumPeriodReturn.23: Umubiri ukira buhoro buhoro kandi urugero rw’imisemburo rurahinduka.
PostpartumPeriodReturn.25: Konsa bishobora gutinza kugaruka kw’imihango yawe, ariko ingaruka zabyo ziratandukanye ku muntu ku wundi.
PostpartumPeriodReturn.27: Imihango yawe ya mbere ishobora kugaruka nyuma y’ibyumweru bike cyangwa amezi menshi.
PostpartumPeriodReturn.29: Ukwezi gushobora kutaba gutunganye mbere yo gusubira buhoro buhoro mu buryo busanzwe.
PostpartumPeriodReturn.30: Nta gihe kimwe gikurikizwa na bose. Igihe imihango yawe igarukira gishobora gutandukana ku muntu ku wundi, cyane cyane bitewe n’konsa.
PostpartumPeriodReturn.32: Iyo imihango yawe igarutse, ukwezi kwa mbere gushobora gutandukana n’ukwa mbere yo gutwita. By’umwihariko, gushobora kutaba gutunganye mu ntangiriro.
PostpartumPeriodReturn.34: Ukwezi gushobora gufata igihe kugira ngo gusubire mu buryo usanzwe uzi.
PostpartumPeriodReturn.36: Amaraso ashobora gutandukana n’ayo wabonaga mbere yo gutwita.
PostpartumPeriodReturn.38: Kwandika byoroheje bigufasha kwitegereza neza uko ukwezi kwawe guhinduka uko igihe gihita.
PostpartumPeriodReturn.40: Andika umunsi wa mbere w’imihango yawe.
PostpartumPeriodReturn.42: Itegereze buhoro buhoro igihe kiri hagati y’ukwezi n’ukundi.
PostpartumPeriodReturn.44: Itegereze gusa impinduka zose ugereranyije n’ibisanzwe kuri wowe.
PostpartumPeriodReturn.46: Niba hari ikintu cyiyumvikana nk’igidasanzwe, gikomeje cyangwa kigutera impungenge, saba inama umuganga ushinzwe ubuzima.
PostpartumPeriodReturn.47: Kuva amaraso ubona ko ari adasanzwe
PostpartumPeriodReturn.52: Kugaruka kw’imihango nyuma yo kubyara bivuga imihango yawe igarutse nyuma yo kubyara.
PostpartumPeriodReturn.53: Konsa bishobora gutinza kugaruka kw’imihango yawe.
PostpartumPeriodReturn.54: Ukwezi kwa mbere gushobora kutaba gutunganye.
PostpartumPeriodReturn.55: Kwandika amatariki bishobora kugufasha gukurikirana uko ukwezi kwawe guhinduka.
PostpartumPeriodReturn.56: Ibikubiyemo by’amakuru. Ibihe bishobora gutandukana bitewe n’uko buri wese ameze kandi ntibisimbura inama za muganga.
